source.sourceHeadRole: clean candidate base before the tested UI implementation

ownerDesktop.observed: Synthetic owner loaded the overview, company, billing, catalog, packs, discovery, activity, tools, and administrative sections. The local billing page exposed finite Team-plan usage and limits.

ownerMobile.observed: The owner drawer opened at 390x844, retained all company-admin destinations, scrolled within its bounded navigation region, and Escape closed it while restoring focus to Open navigation.

mobileNavigationAccordion.observed: At 390x844 only the active Skills group was expanded initially. Keyboard Enter focused and expanded Discover through its separate button with aria-expanded=true and aria-controls=registry-nav-discover-sections; collapsed groups had zero visible or focusable sublinks. Escape closed the drawer and restored focus to Open navigation.

ownerKeyboard.observed: The desktop command palette found Billing & usage; Enter navigated to /app/billing, and browser Back returned to /app with the overview rendered.

readerNavigation.observed: A synthetic reader accepted an invitation and saw Company, CLI tokens, Settings, and Sources. SSO settings, Billing & usage, and the administrative Audit log were absent from the drawer and command palette.

readerPolicy.observed: Direct /app/policy remained readable, while policy controls and Save/Discard were disabled and the view-only guidance named the owner/admin boundary.

readerSources.observed: Direct /app/upstreams remained readable, while Add source was disabled for the reader; the fixture had no approved source to exercise an import request.

readerBillingDenial.observed: Direct /app/billing rendered the server denial 'Owner or admin access is required for company billing.' and exposed no checkout or portal control.

accessibility.observed: Headless axe checks on owner /app/company reported zero violations at both desktop and mobile viewports. The team access table is a keyboard-focusable labelled scroll region.

validation.observed: Vite client, SSR, and Nitro production build completed successfully; existing chunk-size and dynamic-import warnings were reported.

The existing storage billing contract mismatch remains in packages/storage/src/recovery.ts and packages/storage/test/recovery.test.ts: BillingUsageRecoveryResolver/AtomicRecoveryBilling resolveStorageRecovery returns Promise<unknown> where BillingUsageAdmission requires Promise<MeteredStorageRecoveryResolution>. This evidence change did not modify those files.

limits: This was a local identity/PostgreSQL fixture with a deterministic test billing adapter; no Stripe account, product, price, customer, payment method, charge, or production system was used.
The fixture contained one active company, so company switching and multi-company selector behavior were observed only as a single-option state.
Cloud directory, official makers, topics, and external audit pages were checked for their configured disconnected/empty states; no external skills.sh source was contacted.
This record covers local usability and role-boundary evidence only and does not establish commercial launch readiness.
